topic: Hampton NH 3-year-old Eyas Tran notices newspapers piling up; elderly neighbor found trapped in her basement 3+ days (May 2020)
title: He Was 3. He Noticed What Grown-Ups Missed #truestory
description:
#truestory #neighbors #rescue

"Thank the young boy for his keen observation."

A 3-year-old in Hampton, New Hampshire wanted to drop off his neighbor's paper. There was already a pile. Police found her trapped in her basement after more than 3 days.

#mayorofmainst #truestory #checkonyourneighbors

Source: WHDH, AP, CBS Boston (May 2020)

Retold with AI voice & visuals
fact_notes: WHDH (2020): Hampton, N.H.; 3-year-old boy hailed for alerting police; officers responding to a request for a wellness check around 2 p.m. on Drakes Landing found the woman in her basement trapped inside a small corridor; the little boy had alerted his mother to the pile of newspapers on his neighbor's porch after he asked to deliver her newspaper; trapped more than three days but still in good spirits; taken to Portsmouth Hospital for minor injuries; Hampton Police statement: 'The Hampton Police would like to thank the young boy for his keen observation and we encourage residents to check on the elderly and vulnerable folks during these uncertain times.' AP via WCAX (2020-05-08): Eyas Tran and his mother went for a walk Wednesday; the boy wanted to put a newspaper on her porch but noticed several more; the woman lives alone, wasn't answering her phone or the door; when police got in they found her trapped; good spirits, minor injuries. Woman's name not given by AP/WHDH, left out. Assumed: looks, clothes, who knocked and called (reported only that she did not answer), the officer's look, the stretcher picture, the outro picture.
